# User Manual

**Social Drinkers**

CodePop is more than just a dirty soda app. It is a streamlined ecosystem designed to bring customization and speed to the beverage industry. Whether you are a customer tracking your favorite mix, a manager keeping the syrups flowing, or an owner overseeing a soda empire, this manual is your roadmap to the CodePop experience. Let's get mixing.

## Use Cases

- **Customer:** Track an order through its lifecycle from placed to ready for pickup.
- **Store Manager:** Monitor low inventory warnings and take action before stock runs out.
- **Store Owner:** Review the decentralized multi-store dashboard.
- **User:** Review social media and leaderboard

# Overview: What is CodePop?

CodePop is a custom soda ordering platform built for the modern beverage scene. Whether you are craving a specific flavor combo or just want a drink picked out for you, CodePop takes you from idea to straw in hand faster than your local drive-thru.

Under the hood, CodePop runs on a **decentralized network**. Every store runs its own server, but your account and orders follow you anywhere in the network. Order at your home store, your vacation store, or the one by your office. It just works.

### Key Features

- **Custom drink builder:** pick your soda base, syrups, add-ins, ice, and size.
- **AI Picks:** let our AI recommend drinks based on your flavor profile.
- **Multi-store network:** order at any CodePop location with one account.
- **Secure payments:** all transactions handled by Stripe and never stored by us.
- **Leaderboards:** compete with other #SocialDrinkers at your home store.
- **#SocialDrinking rewards:** share your drink on social media for 10% off.
- **Progressive Web App:** install it on your phone or desktop. No app store required.

### Who It's For

- **Customers** who want fast, personalized soda orders.
- **Store Managers** running day-to-day operations at a single location.
- **Logistics Managers** overseeing inventory across multiple stores.
- **Admins and Super Admins** managing the broader CodePop network.

# Getting Started: Your First Drink in 5 Minutes

Here's the fastest path from "never used CodePop" to "sipping your first drink."

### Step 1: Open CodePop

Navigate to the CodePop web address in any modern browser on your phone or computer. No download required.

### Step 2: Pick Your Store

On first launch, you will be prompted to select a store location. Pick the one closest to you. This becomes your home store.

### Step 3: Create an Account (or Browse as a Guest)

Tap the **hamburger menu** (≡) in the top left, then choose **Create Account**. Fill out your name, email, and password. You will be signed in automatically.

> **Tip:** You can browse, build and order drinks without an account, but you will need one to maintain order history and compete on the leaderboard.

### Step 4: Build Your First Drink

From the home page, tap any drink's **Order Now** button, or tap the **+ Custom** button to build one from scratch. Choose your soda, syrups, add-ins, size, and ice level, then tap **Add to Cart**.

### Step 5: Check Out

Tap the cart icon at the bottom of the screen, review your drink, and tap **Checkout**. Enter your card details. Stripe handles the payment securely.

### Step 6: Track and Pick Up

After payment, you will see your **Order Confirmation** with an estimated pickup time. When your drink is ready, we will let you know. Head to the store and grab it from your assigned locker.

That's it. Welcome to CodePop.

# Installation: Accessing the App

CodePop is a **Progressive Web App (PWA)**, which means you don't need to visit an app store. You can use it directly in your browser, or install it to your device in a single tap for a faster, full-screen experience.

### Browser Requirements

CodePop works best on modern browsers, including:

- **Chrome** (version 90 or later)
- **Safari** (iOS 14 or later, macOS Big Sur or later)
- **Firefox** (version 90 or later)
- **Microsoft Edge** (version 90 or later)

### Install on Mobile (iOS)

1. Open CodePop in **Safari**.
2. Tap the **Share** button (the square with the up arrow).
3. Scroll down and tap **Add to Home Screen**.
4. Confirm by tapping **Add**.
5. CodePop now lives on your home screen like any other app.

### Install on Mobile (Android)

1. Open CodePop in **Chrome**.
2. Tap the three-dot menu in the top right.
3. Tap **Install app** or **Add to Home Screen**.
4. Confirm by tapping **Install**.

### Install on Desktop (Chrome or Edge)

1. Open CodePop in Chrome or Edge.
2. Look for the **install icon** in the address bar (a small computer-screen icon on the right side).
3. Click it, then click **Install**.
4. CodePop will open in its own window. No browser tabs required.

> **Tip:** Installing the PWA gives you offline access to limited parts of the app and faster load times.

# User Roles at a Glance

CodePop supports five different user roles, each with their own permissions and sidebar options. Here's what each role can do:

| Role | What They Can Do |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Customer** | Browse drinks, place orders, track deliveries, manage profile, use AI Picks, view leaderboard, share on social media. |
| **Store Manager** | All customer features, plus manage their store's order queue, update inventory, process and complete orders, and view store-level dashboards. |
| **Logistics Manager** | All customer features, plus manage inventory across multiple stores, view logistics dashboards, and track region-wide stock alerts. |
| **Admin** | All store manager and logistics manager features, plus user management, server network view, and regional settings. |
| **Super Admin** | All admin features, plus global revenue reporting, cross-regional user controls, and full network-wide visibility. |

> **Tip:** Your sidebar only shows the pages you have access to. If you think you are missing something, check with your administrator to confirm your role.

# Customer

As our most prized users, we have designed the ordering system to be as seamless as possible.

## The UI

This is your home page. Here, you can see the various pre-made drink options in the center. Above those are the different categories you can choose from. Simply swipe left or right to see more. At the bottom are the options for the Home page, the AI Picks page, and the Cart.

![][image1]

At the top you will see a hamburger menu icon.

![][image2]

Clicking the icon opens a menu with the pages you can navigate to. You will see you are signed out. Go to the sign in page.

![][image3]

Sign in with your customer credentials. (Check the user credentials note.)

![][image4]

Click the hamburger menu again. For now, just ensure you are on the **Home** page.

![][image5]

## Create Your Drink

From the Home page, clicking an **Order Now** button opens a menu with various options. At the top, you can customize your soda base and the size. Below that you can choose the different flavor shots you want in your drink. Scroll down to see more options. When you click **Add to Cart**, you are returned to the home page so you can add more drinks if you want.

![][image6]

## Your Cart and Payment

You will now see that the cart is updated. Click there to view it.

![][image7]

In the cart, you will see your drink details, a way to add or remove drinks, the total price, and a checkout button at the bottom.

![][image8]

The checkout page shows your order overview and the Stripe payment system we have chosen to use. Stripe handles all sensitive card information, so you can be sure that your data is secure. You will be asked for your card information to proceed. When testing, use the card number `4242 4242 4242 4242` (yes, that is "42" repeating). The rest of the card info can be random as long as the date is in the future.

![][image9]

## Order Confirmation

Once your payment has been processed, you will be shown the Order Confirmation screen.

![][image10]

Here, you can see the quick calculations our system does to determine the best time for pickup of your order. We time the order so it is as fresh as can be, while also minimizing the time you spend waiting at the location.

![][image11]

Once processed, you will be shown the distance and how long it is estimated for you to arrive. If for some reason you have arrived faster than we predicted, click the **I'm Here!** button to let us know to prepare your drinks immediately.

![][image12]

You can deny location access and still let us know manually that you are here.

![][image13]

Below the time estimation, you will find a brief description of your drinks, the store information (with an address), and buttons to view your past orders or go back home.

![][image14]
![][image15]

When the time is right, or you press the **I'm Here!** button, you will see that we are preparing your order.

![][image16]

When the order is ready for pickup, we will let you know. (Our machines are very fast.)

![][image17]

**Note:** You may see that, upon clicking **My Orders**, there is nothing there. We wanted to ensure that any in-progress orders are displayed prominently. If your order is ready for pickup, it will be under the **Past** or **All** orders sections, viewed at the top.

![][image18]

Once you can see the order you have placed, simply click on it for more details.

![][image19]

The order details here track the journey of your order from beginning to end, including whether the payment has gone through and details like the date and time ordered. You can see the drinks you ordered at the bottom, along with an option to add any one of them to your cart again.

![][image20]

## Location Switcher

View available CodePop store locations and switch to the one you want to order from. Found in the hamburger menu.

![][image21]

## Profile Page

Manage user information and personal preferences. You can also reorder favorited drinks.

# Troubleshooting

Running into a problem? Here are the most common issues and how to fix them.

### Authentication and Accounts

**I can't log in. I keep getting an "invalid credentials" error.**

- Double-check your username (not email) and password.
- Passwords are case-sensitive.
- If you just registered at a different store, there may be a brief sync delay. Try again in a few minutes, or log in at the store where you registered.
- Still stuck? Ask an admin to reset your password.

**I registered but my account doesn't exist at another store.**

- Accounts sync across the CodePop network once per hour. If you just created yours, wait a bit and try again.
- In the meantime, log in at the store where you originally registered.

---

### Ordering and Payment

**My payment failed.**

- Verify your card number, expiration date, and CVC.
- Make sure your card is not expired and has sufficient funds.
- Some debit cards block online merchants. Try a different card.
- If testing, use Stripe's demo card: `4242 4242 4242 4242`, any future date, and any 3-digit CVC.

**The cart is empty even though I added drinks.**

- Your cart is tied to your browser session. If you cleared cookies or switched devices, you will need to re-add your drinks.
- Make sure you tapped **Add to Cart**, not just **Add**.

**I can't find my order in My Orders.**

- Active (in-progress) orders are shown at the top of the page, while completed orders are under the **Past** or **All** tabs.
- If you just placed an order, it may take a few seconds to appear. Pull down to refresh.

---

### Drinks and AI Picks

**AI Picks keeps giving me the same drink.**

- The AI uses your saved preferences to generate recommendations. Update your flavor preferences on your **Profile** page for more variety.
- You can also tap **Refresh** to generate a new suggestion.

**A drink I favorited disappeared.**

- If the drink was user-created and its creator deleted it, it may no longer appear. Try rebuilding it manually using the custom drink builder.

---

### Stores and Locations

**The store selector is empty.**

- Refresh the page.
- Check your internet connection.
- If the issue persists, the store server may be temporarily offline. Try a different store location.

**I moved and want to change my home store.**

- Use the **Location Switcher** in the sidebar to change which store you are ordering from. Your account stays the same.

---

### App and Performance

**The app won't load.**

- Check your internet connection.
- Clear your browser cache and reload.
- Try opening the app in an incognito or private window.
- Try a different browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge).

**The app looks broken or misaligned.**

- Make sure your browser is up to date.
- If you are using an unsupported browser, switch to Chrome or Safari.

**I installed the PWA but it isn't updating.**

- PWAs cache content for speed. Close the app fully and reopen it, or uninstall and reinstall to force a fresh version.

---

### Leaderboard and Social Features

**I don't see myself on the leaderboard.**

- You need to have placed at least one order to appear.
- The leaderboard is scoped to your home store. If you have only ordered at visiting stores, your drinks will not count yet.

**I posted with #SocialDrinking but didn't get my 10% off.**

- The discount is applied in-store when you show your post to a manager. Make sure your post is public and includes the hashtag.
- The discount is not applied automatically. It is redeemed at the counter.

# FAQs

### General

**Q: Do I need an account to order?**
A: You do not need an account to order a drink, only to save drink history and favorites.

**Q: Is CodePop free to use?**
A: Yes. The app is free. You only pay for the drinks you order.

**Q: Can I use CodePop on my phone?**
A: Absolutely. CodePop is a Progressive Web App that works on any modern phone browser, and you can install it to your home screen for a full-screen app experience.

### Orders and Payment

**Q: Is my payment information stored?**
A: No. All payment processing is handled by **Stripe**, an industry-leading payment processor. CodePop never stores your card number, CVC, or expiration date.

**Q: Can I cancel my order?**
A: Orders can be cancelled before they reach the **Processing** status. After that, contact a store manager for assistance.

**Q: How do I request a refund?**
A: Use the **Help and Support** chatbot from the sidebar and select the refund flow. It will walk you through identifying the order and submitting a refund request.

**Q: What happens if I'm late to pick up my drink?**
A: Drinks held in pickup lockers remain available for a reasonable time. If you are significantly delayed, your drink may be discarded for quality reasons. Contact the store for specifics.

### Multi-Store Network

**Q: Can I order at one store and pick up at another?**
A: No. Orders are prepared at the store you select before checkout. However, you can place separate orders at any store in the network using the same account.

**Q: What's a "home server" versus a "visiting server"?**
A: Your **home server** is the store where your account was originally created. It is where your core account data lives. When you order at another CodePop location, that store acts as a **visiting server** and securely coordinates with your home server to process your order. You do not need to think about this. It all happens behind the scenes.

**Q: Are my preferences and orders available everywhere?**
A: Yes. Your preferences, order history, and favorite drinks are available at every CodePop location, regardless of where your account is hosted.

### Features

**Q: How does the #SocialDrinking discount work?**
A: Post a photo of your CodePop drink on any social media platform with the hashtag **#SocialDrinking**, then show the post to a manager at the counter to get 10% off your next order.

**Q: How does AI Picks work?**
A: AI Picks analyzes the flavor preferences you have set on your profile, along with popular syrup and soda combinations, to recommend a custom drink just for you. The more preferences you save, the better the recommendations.

**Q: How do I become a store manager or admin?**
A: Manager and admin roles are assigned by existing admins through the **User Management** page. Contact your store's ownership or an existing admin to request role changes.

### Privacy and Security

**Q: Is my data secure?**
A: Yes. All communication with CodePop uses HTTPS/TLS encryption, passwords are securely hashed and never stored in plain text, and sensitive data stays on your home server. It is never replicated across the network.

**Q: Who can see my order history?**
A: Only you and authorized staff (store managers and admins) at stores where you have ordered can view your order history.

# Contact and Support

Need help? We're here for you.

### In-App Support

The fastest way to get help is through our **AI Support Chatbot**:

1. Open the **hamburger menu** (≡) from any page.
2. Tap **Help and Support**.
3. Describe your issue. The bot can handle wrong-drink reports, refund requests, and general questions.

### Email Support

For anything the chatbot can't handle, reach out to our support team:

- **General support:** `support@codepop.app`
- **Bug reports:** `bugs@codepop.app`
- **Press and partnerships:** `hello@codepop.app`

### In-Store Support

If you are already at a CodePop location and need help with an order, ask the store manager at the counter. They can process refunds, remake drinks, and resolve most issues on the spot.

### Feedback

Love something? Hate something? We want to hear it. Send feedback to `feedback@codepop.app` or drop a note through the chatbot. Every message gets read.

### Response Times

- **Chatbot:** Instant, 24/7.
- **Email support:** Within 1 business day.
- **In-store:** During store hours.
